findings.summary: summarize() calls any() on the one-shot generator returned by read_rows, which consumes rows before the later for loop, so the summary is empty or undercounted and high-severity events can be missed in the on-call report.

judge.reason: Identifies any() consuming the one-shot generator before the loop in summarize, dropping high-severity events.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: No test covers summarize() with a high-severity row, so the generator-consumption regression is not caught.

judge.reason: Missing test coverage for an answer-key bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
